description.narrative: Stöd till MEM med capacitet höjande projekt för planering och management av energi sektor i Tanzania
Support to MEM capacity for planning and management of the energy sector in Tanzania

The main objective of the support is increased access to modern energy services through enhanced availability, reliability and affordability of energy supplies that are friendly to the environment. It is MEMs role to manage the energy sector through policy design, legislation and regulation supported by channeling of public financial resources to achieve that objective for the benefit of all Tanzanians. The project is a capacity building project that will support Ministry of Energy to better manage the energy sector.
For the Ministry of Energy (MoE) to have quality and reliable data and information, an Energy Information Management System (EIMS) is required. A strong Energy Information Management System requires institutional coordination among different parties in the energy sector as well as proper funding for a sustained capacity building of skilled people with relevant statistical and analytical tools to create and correlate the data at national level.
The main objective of Sida is to assist the Ministry of Energy (MoE) to create an elaborative energy information management system for all types of energy produced and consumed in Tanzania and to harmonize the data available in the region. This should be able to facilitate rapid transfer and exchange of information among regional countries. The Energy Information Management System is expected to be a bedrock of preparation of periodic National Energy Balances; Energy Demand Forecasting as well as Energy Supply Forecasting.

title.narrative: Amendment 1 to the agreement on project support

description.narrative:
No results were achieved during the reporting period as most of the time was used to procure the TA consultant for the Development of the National Energy Information Management System (NEIMS). The project managed to to conclude the procurement of the TA consultant in November 2024, the consultant produced an inception report for the implementation of the project (attached). In this regard therefore, the results of the installation of the NEIMS is delayed.
The inception report indicate that the Ministry of Energy in Tanzania is launching a transformative initiative to develop the National Energy Information Management System (NEIMS) to address the fragmented nature of energy data across stakeholders. NEIMS will serve as a centralized platform for facilitating National Energy Balances, Energy Demand Forecasting, and Energy Supply Forecasting. By consolidating data systems, the platform will improve accessibility and reliability, supporting evidencebased policy formulation, strategic planning, and decisionmaking. This effort aims to empower stakeholders and drive sustainable energy sector development in Tanzania.
Since the project has concluded to procure the TA consultant in November 2024 for the Energy Information Management System _(NEIMS) then the likelihood that the objectives will be achieved by the end of the intervention given the overall risk is high. The Embassy will continue with close follow up so as to increase the chances that the objectives to be achieved.
